title: Polynomial-time unary output
statement: Let $f$ be a polynomial-time computable function on bit strings, and let $C,c\in\mathbb{N}$. The function that maps each bit string $y$ to a string of $C\bigl(|f(y)|+1\bigr)^c$ copies of the bit $1$ is polynomial-time computable.
